notes:
Migrated to the unified v2 Fact model (2026-09-12). The old synergy.json was NOT actually still v1 string-key shaped (it already used object-bag source/sink arrays), but it predated the 2026-09-11 SOURCE-zone rework (bare `zone` instead of `to`/`from`), had no `annotations` at all, and carried two bare-presence facts with no real oracle-text basis (`{zone:'Graveyard', subject:'self'}` and `{event:'dies', target:'self'}` — Ardyn's own oracle text has no death-related clause at all, so these were dropped per the standing 'a SOURCE fact must describe a real transition, never bare presence' rule, same as summon-bahamut's own `self-battlefield` precedent).

Facts modeled (8 source + 2 sink, all annotated, ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS added):
- Baseline self-cast (Hand) / self-enters (Battlefield, now correctly carrying `subject:'self'`, which the old bare fact never had).
- 3 real `grantKeyword` facts (Menace/Lifelink/Haste to Demons you control) — the real `continuousKeywordGrants` mechanism (ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #14) was already wired before this task; only the Fact representation itself was migrated (annotations added, reformatted, unchanged targeting).
- NEW: a real `event:'lifegain'` SOURCE fact (`target:{types:{has:['Demon']}}`) extending the standing 'Lifelink always means lifegain-source' exception (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md) to a GRANTED (not printed) Lifelink for the first time — Ardyn's Demons genuinely gain him life via `state.dealDamage`'s real `effectiveKeywords`-based Lifelink check. rosa-resolute-white-mage and zidane-tantalus-thief have the identical granted-Lifelink shape and do NOT have this fact yet — flagged, not fixed here (out of scope for this task).
- Real targeted `event:'exile'` fact (`from:'Graveyard', to:'Exile'`) for 'exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard' — a real, well-defined origin (unlike Phoenix Down's own unspecified-origin exile fact), so this uses the full zone-shaped from/to shape rather than Phoenix Down's bare event-only shape.
- Real `entersBattlefield` fact for the created token, using `subject:{token:'b_5_5_demon'}` (new tokens.ts entry) — the FIXED-shape-token approach (Dwarven Castle Guard's Hero-token precedent), deliberately NOT Relm's Sketching's `target:{types:{hasAny:[...]}}` variable-copy shape, since Ardyn's token always has the same P/T/color/types regardless of which real creature was exiled to make it (only its `name` varies at runtime, in definition.ts's own `custom` effect, untouched by this migration).
- 2 sink facts (graveyard creature presence, you/opp) reformatted `zone`->`to`, otherwise unchanged.

Beginning-of-combat trigger auto-fire: confirmed NOT built (engine.ts's fireOnPhaseEnterTriggers only auto-fires upkeep/endStep, turn.ts's CombatBegin phase has no trigger hook) — same real, documented gap weapons-vendor's own migration (also a beginning-of-combat card, same day) already flagged; left as-is per that established precedent rather than building new engine machinery as a side effect of this fact-migration task. scenarios.ts untouched (still the plain harness.ts Scenario[] style + keywordScenarios legend-rule probe, 2 scenarios total) — already at the 'default 1 + automatic legend-rule extra' shape every other Legendary creature gets, so no further trim needed; the task's own 'trimmed 4->3' framing didn't match the current file (already 2), so nothing further to cut.

verify-synergy.mjs's isArdynDemonGrantFact extended (not replaced) to also exempt the new lifegain fact from forward-evidence checking — same 'real fact, real mechanism, zero possible evidence given this card's plain Scenario style' class as the 3 grantKeyword facts.

find-synergies.mjs diff (isolated within one process against a held-fixed pool snapshot, since the live pool is being concurrently edited by other sessions and a naive before/after whole-script run was confirmed contaminated by that churn): -35/+157 real interaction lines. All 35 losses are the direct, correct consequence of dropping the two unsupportable bare-presence v1 facts (plus the 11 'battlefield presence' lines that just got relabeled to 'enters the battlefield', net zero). ~130 of the 157 gains are a genuine BUG FIX: the v1 self-enters fact never declared `subject:'self'`, so it silently could only ever match UNCONSTRAINED battlefield-presence sinks (`resolveSubject(undefined,...)` is deliberately `undefined` by design, per synergy.ts's own Gaius van Baelsar precedent) — every type-constrained 'a Creature enters the battlefield' want pool-wide (~130 real cards) was invisible to Ardyn before this migration despite Ardyn genuinely being a real Creature. The remaining ~19 duplicate gains are the new token-enters fact independently satisfying the same UNCONSTRAINED sinks a second time (a real, new produce that didn't exist in v1). 3 gains are the new lifegain fact matching real lifegain-payoff sinks (Aerith Gainsborough, Excalibur II, Minwu, White Mage).
knownGaps: engine.ts's fireOnPhaseEnterTriggers has no auto-fire for 'beginning of combat' (only upkeep/endStep) — same real, documented gap weapons-vendor's own migration flagged the same day; this card's scenario still fires onBeginCombat via the plain harness.ts trigger field rather than a real engine-piloted auto-fire.

rosa-resolute-white-mage and zidane-tantalus-thief both grant Lifelink to something else (identical shape to Ardyn's own grant) but do NOT yet have the corresponding lifegain-source fact this task added for Ardyn — flagged for a future pass, not fixed here (out of scope).

find-synergies.mjs's own token registry is empty (`const tokens = {}`, never wired to functional-model/tokens.ts's real TOKENS) — a pre-existing, pool-wide limitation (Dwarven Castle Guard's own Hero-token fact has the same gap), not something this task's own token-subject fact introduces or is expected to fix.

The self-graveyard/self-dies v1 facts were dropped as unsupportable (no real oracle-text basis) rather than migrated — if Ardyn ever gains a real death-triggered ability in a future errata, those facts would need re-adding with real annotations at that point.
